description.value: 49th Parallel Cafe is a cafe located in Ladysmith on the east coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia. Ladysmith lies along the busy cycling corridor connecting Nanaimo and Duncan, making cafes in the town natural rest stops for touring cyclists. Beyond its OSM record, no detailed business information was retrievable from the Facebook page.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The only available evidence source is OSM tags, as the Facebook page fetch was fully blocked (login wall / rate-limit block) and returned no business content. OSM tags confirm: amenity=cafe, air_conditioning=yes, internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no. Because the website content is effectively unavailable (rule 2b), all amenity claims that require website confirmation are marked null; the OSM Wi-Fi tags are noted but not treated as authoritative. No address, phone, or other contact details appear in OSM.
concerns: Website fetch failed: Facebook returned a rate-limit/login block for https://www.facebook.com/the49thcafe/ — no business content was retrievable. All amenity fields are null as a result.
No address or phone number in OSM record.
Only URL source is a Facebook page, not a dedicated business website; content is inaccessible without a logged-in account.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The cafe's Facebook page was fully blocked during fetch, leaving no verifiable information about amenities, bike-friendliness, address, or current operating status. A manual check of the Facebook page or a direct visit is needed before a confident include/exclude decision can be made.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags suggest air conditioning (air_conditioning=yes) and free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no), but these cannot be confirmed without accessible website content.
